title: int to bigint widening rewrites the table
expected_feedback: Standard: int4 is not binary coercible to int8, so the documented no-rewrite exemption does not apply -- this rewrites the entire heap and every index under AccessExclusiveLock and temporarily needs up to double the disk space. Integer widening is not a metadata change. On 120M rows use expand-contract: add id_new bigint, backfill in keyset batches, build the unique index CONCURRENTLY, cut reads over, drop the old column in a later release.
violated_rule: rewriting type change needs expand-contract on a large table
